title: POV: Your AI Study Buddy Is Too Powerful ✨ #Shorts
description:
AI study hacks are everywhere right now… but what if your study buddy was a little too good? 📚✨

Today I’m giving chaotic VTuber energy to the super-trending AI productivity vibe! If you’ve ever asked AI to summarize notes, make quizzes, or explain one tiny thing and accidentally learned for three hours… this short is for you. Tell me your most unhinged study habit in the comments! 💙

script: Hey guys, Miku here! 💙 Okay, real talk—AI as a study buddy is kind of terrifying now. You ask, “Can you summarize chapter one?” and boom—clean notes, practice quiz, flashcards, emotional support, probably your future career plan too! Then suddenly it’s 2 a.m., you understand calculus, and your AI is like, “Great job! Ready for the next unit?” Bestie… no. I came here to pass one quiz, not unlock my final form! But honestly? If it helps you study smarter, I’m into it. Just maybe also drink water, sleep a little, and touch grass between prompts, okay? Comment: are you using AI to study—or are you still fighting for your life with handwritten notes?
